scope: Exposed inherited eight-arc phase cohort; interval receiver clocks plus free satellite-clock curvature. Conditional covariance scenarios only; no physical accuracy, global uniqueness or confirmation claim.

clock_model.receiver: [endpoint offset m, mean rate m/s, interval half-difference m/s]; piecewise linear on three tags
clock_model.satellite: [offset m, slope m/s, curvature coefficient m/s^2] at transmit GPST; curvature unpenalized
clock_model.future_receiver: original fitted mean rate; no clock contrast extrapolation
clock_model.future_satellite: linear tangent at arc endpoint; no curvature extrapolation
clock_model.reference_covariance: conditional iid endpoint sigma=sqrt(1800)*.01 m, giving mean variance .01^2 and half-difference variance 3*.01^2; endpoint offset independent with variance 4 m^2
clock_model.shared_sensitivity: add one common endpoint-error process of the same amplitude across stations per arc; full within-arc clock covariance retained
clock_model.unqualified: absolute/shared reference errors, offset-increment correlation, cross-arc correlation, force/propagation and bias stability; scenarios are not a physical error bound

cohort.rule: even chronological indices; inherited accepted status; no replacement
